At the frustrated point of a $\pi$ junction the Josephson energy is maximal,
\begin{equation}
1 - \cos\varphi = 2, \qquad \varphi \equiv \pi .
\label{eq:pi}
\end{equation}
For small $\varphi$ the junction behaves as a harmonic oscillator,
\begin{equation}
1 - \cos\varphi = \frac{\varphi^2}{2} + O(\varphi^4) .
\label{eq:harm}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
